infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: San uses your photo library so you can attach photos to posts and chat messages and set your profile banner or a chat background.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: San saves a photo from a chat, or a profile QR code, to your photo library when you tap Save.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: San uses the camera only to scan QR codes, such as someone's profile code. Nothing is recorded or sent.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: San uses the microphone only while you dictate a message, to turn your speech into the text of that message. Nothing is recorded or saved.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: When you dictate a message, San turns your speech into text with Apple's speech recognition. Only the text goes into your message; San does not keep the audio.
